introduction: Delaware TANF provides temporary cash support to eligible families with children. DSS assesses financial circumstances and explains participation requirements.
description: Delaware TANF provides temporary cash support to eligible families with children. DSS assesses financial circumstances and explains participation requirements.

sections.who: A related minor child, specified pregnancy circumstances or eligible student circumstances can establish a family category. Income and resource limits also apply.
sections.get: TANF combines temporary financial support with responsibilities aimed at employment and family stability. Time limits and requirements should be discussed with the case manager.
sections.docs:
• Household and child or pregnancy records.
  • Income, resources and child-care expense information.
  • Documents relevant to any barrier to work or required activities.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through a state channel

    Use ASSIST, a paper application or a State Service Center, as linked on DHSS TANF.

  2. Attend the DSS interview

    Explain family circumstances and submit requested evidence.

  3. Confirm the case requirements

    Ask the case manager to explain approved activities, reporting duties and any applicable exemptions.
sections.after: Keep appointments and notices. Do not rely on the state page’s expired 2025–2026 financial table for a new filing year.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Delaware TANF eligibility and application. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is TANF available to every unemployed adult?
No. Family-category and financial requirements apply.
Is an interview part of intake?
Yes. The state lists a DSS social-worker interview.
Can I use an old income table?
Ask DSS for the limits effective for your application date.
